name: Identify Backdoored PHP Version

decision_points.if: X-Powered-By header indicates a development version of PHP
decision_points.then: Investigate this specific PHP version for known vulnerabilities

success_indicators: discovery of a development version of PHP in HTTP headers

name: Exploit Backdoored PHP RCE via User Agent
execution: craft http request with User-Agent header containing 'zorodium' followed by php code
execute system command via netcat listener if shell is obtained

decision_points.if: HTTP request with crafted User-Agent triggers backdoor

success_indicators: successful execution of commands like 'sleep' or 'wget'
follow_up: Obtain Reverse Shell via Backdoored PHP

name: Obtain Reverse Shell via Backdoored PHP
execution: craft http request with User-Agent header containing 'zorodium' and a reverse shell command

decision_points.if: Backdoored PHP RCE allows execution of system commands

success_indicators: netcat listener receives incoming connection establishing a shell

name: Stabilize Shell

decision_points.then: Use python pty module to spawn a bash shell

success_indicators: interactive shell with proper terminal emulation (e.g., clear screen works)

name: Enumerate User Privileges with Sudo

decision_points.if: User can run 'knife' as root via sudo
decision_points.then: Investigate 'knife' binary for privilege escalation via GTFOBins

success_indicators: ability to run 'knife' as root via sudo

name: Privilege Escalation with Knife Exec

decision_points.if: Knife binary can be used with exec and allows command execution
decision_points.then: Execute 'id' command to confirm root privileges

success_indicators: output of 'id' command shows root user
